confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Berlin price levels and the supplied mid-2026 Vienna and Athens observations; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Beer, coffee, inexpensive-meal and mid-range meal anchors are moderately confident. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July demand and event-driven rate spikes can move them a lot, and the hostel anchors follow the supplied Vienna calibration, which may understate peak-July Berlin dorm and private-room rates. Cocktail and wine anchors rest on weaker direct knowledge and were set from their typical relationship to the beer anchor.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated to the supplied Vienna and Athens mid-2026 observations: Berlin sits modestly below Vienna for beer, coffee, restaurant meals and three-star hotels, is close to Vienna for hostel rooms and basic hotel rooms, and is close to Athens for inexpensive meals. Tbilisi served only as a low-end sanity check.
